issues: 手机 132×264 加边框后高 278，超出 270 的设计画高，整片里手机顶和底一直被画框裁掉
手机只是一圈 7px 纯黑描边，没有任何硬件细节；屏内是灰色渐变块加灰条骨架
chip 文案是 "Feature one / Feature detail" 占位，白胶囊没有图标，也只有一层投影
同心圆是平涂色块，底色平铺，波纹读作色环而不像水面
changes: 手机改为 112×234 屏 + 6px 边框（整机 124×246，上下各留 12px 完整入画），chip 贴边偏移 86→76px 同步改；切 DesignStage raster="zoom"，屏内小字按目标尺寸排版、光栅化
硬件 mockup：145° 金属渐变边框 + 内外发丝环、灵动岛、三枚侧键、静态玻璃斜反光、home 条，两层落地投影（贴近实影 + 远处大柔影）
屏内改为出版级假 feed：9:41 状态栏（渐隐压住滚上来的内容）、日期眉题 + "Today" 大标题 + 完成度进度条、8 条带插画缩略图/标题/元信息/勾选点的条目；匀速自动滚屏 0→−150px 不变
chip 改为带强调色图标 tile 的 "Offline sync / Smart reminders"，发丝描边 + 内高光 + 两层阴影，pop 时再从手机侧外移 6px 弹出（outBack 0.8→1、左 0.22 右 0.40、±3px 悬浮不变）
同心圆每层加上半受光渐变、内上沿白高光和白色发丝外缘，读作一圈圈水面反光；底色改为上亮下暗的极低对比渐变，手机身后加柔光，四角轻压暗；ACCENT_RGB 改为与 fixture 一致的 #5b63d3
issuesEn: At 132×264 plus bezel the phone stood 278 tall, more than the 270 design height, so its top and bottom were cropped by the frame for the whole shot
The phone was just a 7px solid-black outline with no hardware detail; the screen held grey gradient blocks and skeleton bars
The chips read "Feature one / Feature detail" as placeholders, with plain white pills, no icons and a single shadow
The concentric circles were flat fills on a flat background, reading as colour rings rather than water
changesEn: Phone is now a 112×234 screen plus 6px bezel (124×246 overall, 12px clear top and bottom), with the chip offset changed 86→76px to match; DesignStage switches to raster="zoom" so on-screen small text is laid out and rasterized at target size

Hardware mockup: 145° metal-gradient bezel with inner and outer hairline rings, Dynamic Island, three side buttons, a static diagonal glass reflection, a home bar, and two-layer ground shadows (tight contact plus a large soft falloff)

The screen is now a publication-grade mock feed: a 9:41 status bar (faded over content scrolling beneath it), a date eyebrow, a "Today" large title and a progress bar, then eight items with illustrated thumbnails, titles, meta lines and check dots; the linear 0→−150px auto-scroll is unchanged

Chips are now "Offline sync / Smart reminders" with an accent icon tile, hairline border, inner highlight and two-layer shadow, and they slide 6px out from the phone's side as they pop (outBack 0.8→1, left at 0.22, right at 0.40, ±3px float all unchanged)

Each ring gets a lit upper-half gradient, a white top inner highlight and a white hairline rim, so they read as ripples catching light; the background is a very low-contrast light-to-dark gradient with a soft glow behind the phone and lightly darkened corners; ACCENT_RGB now matches the fixture's #5b63d3
